critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx split_executado handler (line 61-66) adds ev.valor_plataforma (=commission=2.5) to stats.receita. That means the 'live' Receita do Sistema after a €50 sale only bumps by €3 not €50 (matches server-side revenue on next reload, but UX-wise inconsistent with backend semantics where revenue == amount, not commission). The observed 50 € live in this iteration only worked because dashboards.totals.revenue was refreshed via teste_limpo/load between events; a run that finishes before load() would show +3 €, not +50 €. Consider using ev.valor_total for receita and keep ev.valor_plataforma for comissoes.
routes_test.py _delete_test (line 88-92) is dead code — delete_test_run and clear_all_tests don't call it. Safe to remove to avoid confusion.

routes_test.py test_run has hard-coded rate=0.05 for commission while the real /api/redeem/qr uses partner.rate. In test mode the influencer sees +2.5 € commission but a production redemption at same partner might use a different rate. Consider looking up partner rate for consistency.

TestRunDialog.jsx step-progress transitions off the 'run' state may briefly show wait for step 3 & 4 because backend emits {estado:'run'} then {estado:'ok'} back-to-back; UI copes fine but flicker possible on slow WS.
routes_test.py clear-all audit_log deletion regex '· TESTE ·' assumes exact spacing; if audit format ever changes those rows will leak. Prefer marking test audit rows with a boolean flag.

InfluencerDashboard toast uses eur(ev.valor_plataforma) which formats 2.5 as '2,50 €' — good; but the review request expected the KPI to increase 'by 2,50 € rounded' — currently rounded to 3 € due to Math.round on Receita/Comissão KpiCards. Consistent with rest of app, but flag if precise decimals expected.

seed_data_creation: During tests: multiple TEST- campaigns/claims/redemptions were created and then removed. Final cleanup: POST /api/admin/test-run/clear-all {confirm:'LIMPAR'} → DB clean (0 test rows, only CLUB-10 campaign, dashboards.revenue=0). Verified via /api/dashboard/admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WS event key is 'tipo' (not 'type'). New alias event 'venda_validada' emitted alongside 'venda' and 'split_executado' in test-run and should also be emitted by production redemption if code paths align (currently only routes_test.py emits it explicitly — verify routes_data.py / routes_payments.py also emit venda_validada if that's the intended alias). test-run POST is synchronous (~4s wall clock due to internal await asyncio.sleep(0.6..0.9) per step); the endpoint returns only after step 6. WS 'teste_passo' events are broadcast to all admin dashboards concurrently. AdminDashboard.load() is called on teste_limpo which is emitted by DELETE /api/admin/test-run/{id} and POST /api/admin/test-run/clear-all. Frontend Receita counter uses ev.valor_plataforma (commission), not ev.valor_total. Backend expects body.confirm strings exactly 'RESET-ALL' / 'LIMPAR'.
rca of the issue: No production bugs. Notable: (1) Frontend AdminDashboard live-increments Receita by commission (2.5 €) instead of total (50 €); UI eventually correct via load() on teste_limpo, but WS-only increment is understated by 20x. (2) Dead code _delete_test in routes_test.py. (3) Rate hardcoded at 5% in test mode, may diverge from partner.rate in production. Flagged for main agent.
